title: The creator economy’s ad revenue problem and India’s AI ambitions
description: The creator economy is evolving fast, and ad revenue alone isn’t cutting it anymore. YouTubers are launching product lines, acquiring startups, and building actual business empires. In fact, MrBeast’s company bought fintech startup Step, and his chocolate business is outearning his media arm. This isn’t just one creator’s strategy. For many, it’s the new playbook.  On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, hosts Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, and Rebecca Bellan unpack how creators are diversifying beyond ads, […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: Why creators are ditching ad revenue for chocolate bars and fintech acquisitions
description: The creator economy is evolving fast, and ad revenue alone isn’t cutting it anymore. YouTubers are launching product lines, acquiring startups, and building actual business empires. In fact, MrBeast’s company bought fintech startup Step, and his chocolate business is out-earning his media arm. This isn’t just one creator’s strategy. For many, it’s the new playbook.  […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Rebecca Bellan, Kirsten Korosec

title: Anthropic-funded group backs candidate attacked by rival AI super PAC
description: Dueling pro-AI PACs have centered around backing or targeting one New York congressional bid: Alex Bores, whose RAISE Act requires AI developers to disclose safety protocols and report serious system misuse.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: InScope nabs $14.5M to solve the pain of financial reporting
description: The startup, founded by accountants who worked at Flexport, Miro, Hopin and Thrive Global, automates the difficulties of prepping financial statements.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Great news for xAI: Grok is now pretty good at answering questions about Baldur’s Gate
description: A new report from Business Insider reveals that high-level engineers at xAI were pulled off other projects to make sure Grok could answer detailed questions about the video game Baldur's Gate.
author: Russell Brandom

title: ‘Toy Story 5’ takes aim at creepy AI toys: ‘I’m always listening’
description: Addictive, AI-enabled tablets are taking over, and also, Woody is balding in the new Toy Story movie, out June 19.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: AI’s promise to indie filmmakers: Faster, cheaper, lonelier
description: AI expands access to filmmaking for resource-constrained creators. But as efficiency becomes the industry’s north star, creativity risks being overwhelmed by a deluge of low-effort, AI-generated content.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Peak XV raises $1.3B, doubles down on AI as global VC rivalry in India heats up
description: Peak XV says most of its new capital will target India as the firm prioritizes AI, fintech and cross-border bets while navigating recent partner departures.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Super Early Bird rates end in 1 week
description: The lowest ticket rates of the year for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 end next Friday, February 27. Save up to $680 on your pass. Register now before prices increase.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: OpenAI says 18 to 24-year-olds account for nearly 50% of ChatGPT usage in India
description: The company said on Friday that users between 18 and 24 years of age account for nearly 50% of all messages sent by Indians to ChatGPT, and users under 30 accounted for 80% of usage in the country.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: UAE’s G42 teams up with Cerebras to deploy 8 exaflops of compute in India
description: Abu Dhabi-based tech company G42 has partnered with U.S.-based chipmaker Cerebras to deploy eight exaflops of compute through a new system in India
author: Ivan Mehta

title: General Catalyst commits $5B to India over five years
description: The pledge marks a sharp jump from General Catalyst's earlier $500 million–$1 billion India earmark.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Google’s new Gemini Pro model has record benchmark scores — again
description: Gemini 3.1 Pro promises a Google LLM capable of handling more complex forms of work.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Nvidia deepens early-stage push into India’s AI startup ecosystem
description: Nvidia is working with investors, nonprofits, and venture firms to build earlier ties with India's fast-growing AI founder ecosystem.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Why these startup CEOs don’t think AI will replace human roles
description: The CEOs of Read AI and Lucidya told TechCrunch at Web Summit Qatar that they see AI tools replacing tasks, rather than workers.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: YouTube’s latest experiment brings its conversational AI tool to TVs
description: YouTube is testing conversational AI on smart TVs, allowing viewers to ask the assistant questions related to the video they're watching on the big screen.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Reddit is testing a new AI search feature for shopping
description: A small group of users in the U.S. will start to see search results that include interactive product carousels with pricing, images, and direct where-to-buy links.
author: Aisha Malik

title: All the important news from the ongoing India AI Impact Summit
description: India is hosting a four-day AI Summit this week that will be attended by executives from major AI labs and Big Tech, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, and Cloudflare, as well as heads of state.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI reportedly finalizing $100B deal at more than $850B valuation
description: OpenAI is reportedly getting close to closing a $100 billion deal, with backers including Amazon, Nvidia, SoftBank, and Microsoft. The deal would value the ChatGPT-maker at $850 billion.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Reload wants to give your AI agents a shared memory
description: Reload announces a $2.275 million raise in a round led by Anthemis and the launch of its first AI employee, Epic.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis
